chronology.1_sequence_universe_and_split_rule: the MOT20 sequence universe (MOT20-01/02/03/05) and the second-half split rule were frozen in 02_PROSPECTIVE_PROTOCOL BEFORE any MOT17 execution.
chronology.2_evaluator_native_semantics: MOT20 evaluator-native GT semantics (09A) were completed AFTER MOT17 outcomes were known but BEFORE any MOT20 outcome existed.
chronology.3_readiness_audit: the readiness audit (record 10) then established that most public MOT20 checkpoints are unsuitable for the held-out half-train estimand because of evaluation leakage.
chronology.4_selection_basis: Deep-OC-SORT was carried forward for possible execution ONLY because that pre-existing readiness audit classified its documented validation path as the sole NO_KNOWN_EVAL_LEAKAGE cell.
chronology.wording_prohibition: this selection must NOT be described as a prospectively selected winner, nor as outcome-based selection, nor as a best-performing method.

clean_cell.note: READY_FOR_AUTHORIZATION is a readiness state introduced by this amendment. It is NOT EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED and confers no permission to run anything.

original_10_classification.why_incomplete: BLOCKED_ASSET alone reads as a procurable blocker. It is not. The missing artifact is S0, the OC-SORT MOT20 linear-DTI state, which can only be produced by the OC-SORT MOT20 detector whose training set contains the frozen evaluation frames. Acquiring any asset cannot make this cell valid for the clean held-out V9 estimand.

the absence of a MOT20 val experiment config is not the only blocker; record 10 already listed CONFIRMED_EVAL_LEAKAGE among additional_blockers, but the single headline classification understated it. Even if a val config existed, the only MOT20 detector Hybrid-SORT documents is trained on the frozen evaluation frames.
